macro.description: Tactic step 「推导」. A derivation step with no more specific tactic. Block mode so the renderer can put the tactic label in its own column (Mitar's `step-tag`); the label is derived from the macro name and is never stored in the tree. Dynamic arity: the children are the step's prose run, which may interleave text with citation nodes.
macro.name: Proof.tac.derive
